name: AP-1060E Automatic Die Cutting Machine
tagline: High-Speed Precision Die Cutting with Advanced Stripping System
description: The AP-1060E is our flagship fully automatic die-cutting and creasing machine, engineered for heavy-duty industrial printing and packaging lines. Featuring a state-of-the-art stripping station, it delivers flawless high-speed throughput with minimal manual intervention, ideal for corrugated boxes, cosmetics packaging, and premium carton manufacturing.
features: Non-stop feeder and delivery system to maximize productivity
Pneumatic lock chase system for rapid die setup changes
Highly accurate side lay with photo-electric sensors for register control
Dynamic high-speed triple-action stripping system
Imported premium indexing gearbox and drive mechanisms
Overload protection clutch system for safety and machine longevity

name: MH-1050 Manual Platen Die Cutting Machine
tagline: Industrial-Grade Platen Press for Solid Board and Heavy Corrugated Sheets
description: Built for robust durability and ultimate flexibility, the MH-1050 is a heavy-duty hand-fed platen die cutter and creaser. With its solid cast-iron frames and high-torque electromagnetic clutch system, it handles thick materials, solid board, and heavy-gauge corrugated sheets with unmatched reliability and pressure distribution.
features: High-tensile frame structure made from superior quality alloy cast iron
Electromagnetic clutch and brake system for prompt and reliable response
Safety sensors and multi-stage emergency trip bars surrounding the platen
Centralized manual lubrication pump system for all moving joints
Adjustable dwell-timer for holding pressure on thick substrates
Stepless micro-adjustment dial for precise impression depth control

name: HSC-1300 High-Speed Web-Fed Roll Die Cutter
tagline: Advanced Continuous Roll-Fed Die Cutting for Paper Cup & Label Production
description: The HSC-1300 is an ultra-efficient roll-fed die cutting machine designed specifically for label production, paper cup blanks, and mass-market paper containers. Feeding from large web reels, it uses a servo-driven web tension control and photo-eye register to continuously die-cut and stack products at phenomenal speeds, drastically reducing waste material.
features: Shaftless hydraulic unwind roll loader for easy reel changes
Double servo-motor drive system for unmatched web-register precision
Pneumatic lift-and-separate plate lock for roll tooling changeovers
Integrated web guiding system (EPC/LPC) for lateral drift control
Automatic count-and-stack delivery conveyor table
Pre-integrated tension sensing powder brake controllers

name: TM-1050FC Foil Stamping & Die Cutting Machine
tagline: Premium Foil Stamping, Embossing, and Die Cutting in a Single Pass
description: Unify premium finishing with high precision. The TM-1050FC combines automatic hot foil stamping, deep multi-level embossing, and die cutting in a single operational flow. Powered by multi-zone intelligent heating platens and programmable servo foil feeders, this machine is the gold standard for high-end luxury cosmetics, wine cartons, and boutique gift wrap.
features: 12 independently controlled heating zones for absolute thermal uniformity
Dual transverse and triple longitudinal servo-driven foil feed shafts
Pneumatically sliding honeycomb plate for simple foil lockup setting
Advanced holographic foil registration tracking system (Optional)
High-precision dwell control for deep, dramatic embossing depth
Full safety interlocks and electronic double-sheet detection systems

name: ANYCUT-F6090 Automatic Flatbed Cutter
tagline: Dual-Head High-Speed Digital Flatbed Cutter & Creaser
description: The ANYCUT-F6090 is an advanced digital flatbed cutting machine featuring dual tool heads, auto contour camera recognition, and high-speed servo motors. Engineered for precise cutting, creasing, and plotting across cardboard, kraft paper, PVC, and self-adhesive materials without needing traditional cutting dies.

technicalSpecs.Connection Interface: WiFi / USB / Network Port / QR Code Recognition
technicalSpecs.Suitable Cutting Materials: Cardboard, Coated Film, Self-Adhesive, Kraft Paper, PVC, PET
technicalSpecs.Supported Software: CDR, AI, PS, Contour Software, SignMaster (Optional)

features: Dual tool head system supporting cutting, creasing, and drawing in a single setup
CCD Camera auto contour positioning with L-corner, Dot, and QR code recognition
Ultra-precise ±0.01 mm cutting accuracy with high-speed servo motor drive
Supports diverse materials including cardboard up to 450 gsm, PVC, PET, and self-adhesive film
5.0-inch interactive touch screen control panel for intuitive operation
Flexible connectivity options via WiFi, USB, Network Port, and offline QR Code operation
